name: Am I Covered?
tagline: Translates US insurance policies into plain English, coverage by coverage
description: Point it at a policy - homeowners or condo, renters, flood and auto cover, umbrella protection, or a small-business contract - and get a straight explanation of what the document actually obligates and excludes. Written for policyholders who hold coverage they cannot parse, in plain English.
author: CantBeatDees
